decisions.reason: Cleaning soap requires chemical expertise unrelated to wood manufacturing, limiting the firm's ability to learn from early results and improve the product.
Maintenance oil is a chemical formulation outside the firm's core wood processing knowledge, making it hard to assimilate market feedback and likely to be dropped.
Care product for oiled floors also relies on chemical know-how not present in the firm, so absorptive capacity is low and dropping is likely.
Floor underlay with moisture protection leverages existing flooring market knowledge and installation expertise, so the firm can interpret feedback and keep improving it.
High density foam underlay is adjacent to flooring but requires polymer knowledge; however, distribution synergies allow moderate learning and justify keeping it.
Oak parquet floor builds directly on the firm's core wood processing capabilities, ensuring high absorptive capacity and a strong basis for improvement.
